description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Dismiss Mr. S. H. M. Mujahir from the Post of Chairman ship and the Membership of the Manner Pradeshiya Sabha with effect from 14.09.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the dismissal of a local government official (Chairman of the Pradeshiya Sabha of Mannar) due to misconduct and disqualification under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act. It involves judicial inquiry findings and the exercise of gubernatorial authority in a law enforcement/disciplinary capacity related to local government administration, falling under Judicial/Law Enforcement matters rather than central government personnel or structural changes.
